title: Pods miss the engine assets: the once-per-session heal never reaches a swapped volume
description: js/shell.js ran the remote drift heal + engine-asset install ONCE per app session (_didFirstConnectDriftCheck). 2026-10-09 Fabio connected a warm volume first, then moved to a fresh one (lpja78wof3): no taef2/sam3/qwen3vl/hand-yolo there, Klein previews fell back to Latent2RGB. Fix: both heals on every connect edge + one [download] line per remote install. Proof and checks in validation.md.
